rule.name: ShrinkingWorklistJoin
rule.message: This worklist pass joins the output of each block into the stored input of its successor (input.get(next).addAll(out)), but the transfer removes facts from a copy of the state depending on the facts it holds (removeIf, retainAll, clear, or remove and removeAll of values taken from the state). A join never takes back what an earlier pass sent along the same edge, so the successor keeps an old, stronger fact after the loop comes round with a weaker one, and the pass reports results that are not true. Store the last output per edge and recompute the input of a block from all of them whenever one changes, or make the transfer only add facts.
